data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: claude-subconscious
ui_devex.summary: Claude Subconscious 是一个 TypeScript 库，为 Claude Code 添加了持久化背景处理层，以克服传统 AI 编程助手单轮交互的局限。它使 Claude 能够跨会话保持上下文，持续处理信息，并在无需明确提示时回忆先前工作。该库模拟人类潜意识机制，帮助 AI 记忆项目决策、编码模式和技术背景。开发者可将其集成至工作流，实现多步骤问题解决、跨会话项目维护，从而构建更智能的开发环境，使编程助手真正记住用户的技术思路与习惯。
ui_devex.summary_en: Claude Subconscious is a TypeScript library that enhances Claude Code's reasoning by adding persistent background processing capabilities, addressing the limitation of single-turn interactions in AI coding assistants. It implements a subconscious-like layer where Claude can maintain context across sessions, process information continuously, and recall previous work without explicit prompting. Developers can integrate it into their Claude Code workflows to enable multi-step problem solving, maintain project context between coding sessions, and build more sophisticated AI-assisted development environments where the assistant remembers technical decisions and patterns.

agents_workflows.name: litellm
agents_workflows.summary: LiteLLM是一个统一的Python SDK和代理服务器，解决了管理多个大语言模型API的复杂性，通过提供标准化的OpenAI兼容接口简化开发流程。其技术核心在于通过智能路由和格式转换抽象不同供应商的API差异，让开发者只需少量代码修改即可在100多个LLM提供商间灵活切换。你可以直接将其作为OpenAI客户端的替代品来实验不同模型，实现跨供应商的成本追踪，或部署为生产环境网关，利用内置的负载均衡和安全护栏构建可靠的LLM应用系统。
agents_workflows.summary_en: LiteLLM is a unified Python SDK and proxy server that solves the complexity of managing multiple large language model APIs by providing a standardized OpenAI-compatible interface. Its technical innovation lies in abstracting away vendor-specific differences through intelligent routing and format translation, allowing developers to switch between 100+ LLM providers with minimal code changes. You can use it as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI's client to experiment with different models, implement cost tracking across providers, or deploy it as a production gateway with built-in load balancing and guardrails for reliable LLM operations.

agents_workflows.name: strix
agents_workflows.summary: Strix是一个开源AI驱动的渗透测试框架，通过自动化漏洞发现解决人工安全审计的挑战。它利用LLM驱动的智能体模拟黑客行为，系统性地识别SQL注入、跨站脚本等常见漏洞。技术核心在于将安全测试任务分解为可执行的代理动作，使大语言模型能够像安全专家一样思考攻击路径。开发者可将其集成到CI/CD流程中实现持续安全测试，安全团队则可用它辅助人工渗透测试，快速扫描应用弱点并生成修复建议。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing framework that automates vulnerability discovery in applications, addressing the challenge of manual security audits. It employs LLM-driven agents that simulate hacker behaviors to systematically identify weaknesses like SQL injection and XSS. Developers can integrate it into CI/CD pipelines for continuous security testing, or security teams can use it to augment manual penetration testing with automated scanning capabilities.

deployment_serving.summary_en: LiteLLM is a unified Python SDK and proxy server that solves the complexity of managing multiple large language model APIs by providing a standardized OpenAI-compatible interface. Its technical innovation lies in abstracting away vendor-specific differences through intelligent routing and format translation, allowing developers to switch between 100+ LLM providers with minimal code changes. You can use it as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI's client to experiment with different models, implement cost tracking across providers, or deploy it as a production gateway with built-in load balancing and guardrails for reliable LLM operations.

framework_core.name: strix
framework_core.summary: Strix是一个开源AI驱动的渗透测试框架，通过自动化漏洞发现解决人工安全审计的挑战。它利用LLM驱动的智能体模拟黑客行为，系统性地识别SQL注入、跨站脚本等常见漏洞。技术核心在于将安全测试任务分解为可执行的代理动作，使大语言模型能够像安全专家一样思考攻击路径。开发者可将其集成到CI/CD流程中实现持续安全测试，安全团队则可用它辅助人工渗透测试，快速扫描应用弱点并生成修复建议。
framework_core.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing framework that automates vulnerability discovery in applications, addressing the challenge of manual security audits. It employs LLM-driven agents that simulate hacker behaviors to systematically identify weaknesses like SQL injection and XSS. Developers can integrate it into CI/CD pipelines for continuous security testing, or security teams can use it to augment manual penetration testing with automated scanning capabilities.

framework_core.name: claude-subconscious
framework_core.summary: Claude Subconscious 是一个 TypeScript 库，为 Claude Code 添加了持久化背景处理层，以克服传统 AI 编程助手单轮交互的局限。它使 Claude 能够跨会话保持上下文，持续处理信息，并在无需明确提示时回忆先前工作。该库模拟人类潜意识机制，帮助 AI 记忆项目决策、编码模式和技术背景。开发者可将其集成至工作流，实现多步骤问题解决、跨会话项目维护，从而构建更智能的开发环境，使编程助手真正记住用户的技术思路与习惯。
framework_core.summary_en: Claude Subconscious is a TypeScript library that enhances Claude Code's reasoning by adding persistent background processing capabilities, addressing the limitation of single-turn interactions in AI coding assistants. It implements a subconscious-like layer where Claude can maintain context across sessions, process information continuously, and recall previous work without explicit prompting. Developers can integrate it into their Claude Code workflows to enable multi-step problem solving, maintain project context between coding sessions, and build more sophisticated AI-assisted development environments where the assistant remembers technical decisions and patterns.
